This highlights the growing role of AI in healthcare and the need for careful ethical considerations.
key_points: AI algorithms differ from human doctors on organ transplant eligibility.
AI's data-driven criteria challenge traditional medical decision-making.
This raises complex ethical questions about AI's role in healthcare.

Health.headline: Women in health earn 19% less than men, WHO warns
Health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued a warning that women working in the health sector globally earn, on average, 19% less than their male counterparts. This significant gender pay gap highlights persistent inequalities within the healthcare industry. The WHO urges action to address these disparities and promote equitable compensation.
key_points: WHO reports women in health earn 19% less than men globally.
This highlights significant gender pay inequality in healthcare.
The organization calls for action to address these disparities.

Health.headline: Fiji declares national HIV crisis as cases spike
Health.summary: Fiji has officially declared a national HIV crisis following a significant spike in new cases across the country. The government and health organizations are mobilizing resources to address the urgent public health challenge. This declaration aims to raise awareness, increase testing, and enhance prevention and treatment efforts.
key_points: Fiji declared a national HIV crisis due to a spike in cases.
Government and health organizations are mobilizing resources.
The goal is to boost awareness, testing, prevention, and treatment.
